dogecoin.text:
Meme coins mooning while your portfolio's in the gutter?  
Little Pepe's building a blockchain empire,  
and Dogecoin's still Elon's pet.  
AI coins flex, but half these tokens are just hype-dust.  
Wake up, degens - chase the alpha, not the FOMO! 🐸

Cats slapping dogs out of crypto?  
CatSlap and MEW are mooning,  
while Dogecoin's stuck in 2021.  
Solaxy's got Layer2 swagger,  
but Trump coins? Pure election scam.  
AI-Pepe thinks it's smarter than you.  
Pick your poison, degens.

Yo, crypto degens!  
$DOGE pumps on Elon's whim,  
$PEPE's just a meme dream.  
Layer2 shills $ARB like it's gold,  
while $SOL crashes, cold.  
AI coins? HODL or get rekt.  
This market's a circus,  
bet on the next rug pull! 🫠
